# pdf.js (vendored)

Unmodified copy of `pdfjs-dist@6.4.299` (legacy build, minified), from
https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist — Apache-2.0, see LICENSE.

Used only to read text from PDF invoices locally (Ollama backend).
Update: change the version in package.json, run `npm install`, then `npm run vendor:pdfjs`.
